verdict.rationale: Missive publishes a static REST API endpoint reference with per-endpoint example requests and Markdown/llms.txt versions of its docs. The evidence explicitly states that no live try-it runner and no OpenAPI spec are documented, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger files all returned 404. A static reference with copyable examples is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
